headline: 2 core contracts catalogued on TRON (factory + exchange template); TRON chain not supported by DeFiPunkd read API so on-chain state unverifiable this run.
short_headline: 2 TRON contracts found; on-chain reads blocked

findings.text: D1: TRON block explorer (tronscan.org) is not in the DeFiPunkd supported-chain list and direct fetch was blocked by allowlist. Web search surfaced the JustswapFactory address TXk8rQSAvPvBBNtqSoY6nCfsXWCSSpTVQF and the USDT/TRX exchange address TQn9Y2khEsLJW1ChVWFMSMeRDow5KcbLSE via the official SunSwap API docs PDF and a third-party GitHub reference.

D2: Official SunSwap deployed contracts doc is https://www.sunswap.com/docs/sunswap-interfaces_en.pdf (fetched). It lists V1 factory TXk8rQSAvPvBBNtqSoY6nCfsXWCSSpTVQF and V1 USDT/TRX exchange TQn9Y2khEsLJW1ChVWFMSMeRDow5KcbLSE. A V1.5 factory TB2LM4iegvhPJGWn9qizeefkPMm7bqqaMs and V1.5 exchange TEXsUGyKSapM3cDUpvsShnvE8TqP83qosA are also listed but are out of scope for SUNSwap V1.

D3: Audit PDF at https://sunswap.com/docs/audit-report_en.pdf fetched. Conducted by SlowMist (team@slowmist.com), dated Aug 25, 2020, originally named 'JustSwap'. Scope covers JustswapExchange.sol and JustswapFactory.sol by code hash only — no deployed on-chain addresses listed in the report. Two findings: one low-risk (removeLiquidity pool risk) and one enhancement suggestion (redundant code). Result: Passed.

D4: No GitHub repo recorded for SUNSwap V1 in protocol.github. A third-party mirror repo (github.com/qyvlik/tron-justswap) surfaced in search results and corroborates the factory/exchange addresses, but it was not fetched directly and cannot be used as evidence for admin_addresses.
D5: Protocol.chains = Tron only. Only one chain to enumerate; all D1–D4 results are for Tron mainnet.

D6: JustswapFactory (TXk8rQSAvPvBBNtqSoY6nCfsXWCSSpTVQF) is a factory that spawns per-token exchange contracts. Enumeration via DeFiPunkd read API is impossible because TRON is not a supported chain. Tronscan fetch was blocked by allowlist. Factory cap-out notice recorded in unknowns[].

D7: Role taxonomy applied: factory contract (JustswapFactory) and pool/exchange contract (JustswapExchange, one per TRC20 token). TRON addresses cannot populate the address field (base58 format, not 0x hex). Recorded in unknowns[].

D8: Addresses TXk8rQSAvPvBBNtqSoY6nCfsXWCSSpTVQF and TQn9Y2khEsLJW1ChVWFMSMeRDow5KcbLSE are backed by the fetched official API PDF. They are recorded in evidence[].shows but cannot populate admin_addresses[].address (wrong format for schema). Recorded in unknowns[] with D8 code.

rationale.verdict: grade=unknown because (1) TRON is not a supported chain in the DeFiPunkd read API so no on-chain state could be read, (2) TRON base58 addresses cannot conform to the required 0x-hex address schema, and (3) no GitHub source repo is recorded. The two core addresses (factory and a sample exchange pool) were discovered from the fetched official API documentation PDF, but downstream slices cannot yet verify live state without TRON chain support.

evidence.shows: SlowMist security audit of JustSwap (now SUNSwap V1), dated Aug 25 2020, result Passed. Audited contracts: JustswapExchange.sol and JustswapFactory.sol. No deployed on-chain addresses listed; scope identified by file hashes only. Two findings: low-risk removeLiquidity design defect, and code redundancy enhancement suggestion.

Official SunSwap API documentation (v1.0.4) listing deployed contract addresses: V1 factory contract TXk8rQSAvPvBBNtqSoY6nCfsXWCSSpTVQF; V1 exchange contract (USDT/TRX example) TQn9Y2khEsLJW1ChVWFMSMeRDow5KcbLSE. Factory creates per-token exchange contracts; exchange holds TRX+TRC20 liquidity pools. Also lists V1.5 factory TB2LM4iegvhPJGWn9qizeefkPMm7bqqaMs and V1.5 exchange TEXsUGyKSapM3cDUpvsShnvE8TqP83qosA (out of scope for V1).
SunSwap website confirms: TRON-based decentralized trading protocol for automated liquidity provision, supporting TRC20 token exchanges. JavaScript-rendered frontend returned no contract addresses.

D4: No official GitHub repo recorded for SUNSwap V1; third-party mirror github.com/qyvlik/tron-justswap found in search but not fetched — source code provenance unverified
D6: JustswapFactory (TXk8rQSAvPvBBNtqSoY6nCfsXWCSSpTVQF) spawns thousands of per-token exchange contracts; enumeration via getTokenWithId not possible as TRON is unsupported by DeFiPunkd read API

D7: TRON addresses use base58 format (T-prefix) incompatible with schema address field regex ^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$; factory address TXk8rQSAvPvBBNtqSoY6nCfsXWCSSpTVQF and exchange address TQn9Y2khEsLJW1ChVWFMSMeRDow5KcbLSE cannot be entered in admin_addresses[].address
D8: On-chain owner/admin of JustswapFactory not determinable — TRON chain not supported by DeFiPunkd read API; tronscan.org fetch blocked by allowlist
D8: Actor class (eoa/multisig/timelock/governance) of factory deployer/owner on TRON not determinable this run — offchain-only evidence available

D5: No governance token, timelock, or multisig addresses surfaced for SUNSwap V1; protocol appears to have no admin/pause functions per audit scope (immutable-style design modelled on Uniswap V1) — needs on-chain verification
D2: No dedicated deployed-contracts webpage found beyond the API PDF; protocol_metadata.deployed_contracts_doc set to the PDF URL

protocol_metadata.about: SUNSwap V1 (originally launched as JustSwap in August 2020) is a constant-product automated market maker DEX on the TRON blockchain, enabling permissionless swaps between TRX and any TRC20 token. Users deposit TRX and a TRC20 token into exchange contracts to provide liquidity and earn 0.3% swap fees, receiving LP tokens as proof of share. The protocol uses a factory-and-exchange architecture: a single JustswapFactory contract deploys one JustswapExchange contract per TRC20 token, each maintaining its own TRX/TRC20 reserve pool. The protocol was later rebranded as SunSwap and absorbed into the broader SUN DeFi ecosystem.
